i-understand-clients-reinstall.meaning: Explicit confirmation that clients must reinstall trust. Absence is treated as false and refused.

primitive.meaning: The certificate operation (rotate_ca), or error for the stop-level exception arm.

role.meaning: Normalized appliance profile used by the certificate operation.

changed.meaning: Whether the primitive reports a change; some failure paths may report partial effects.

dry_run.meaning: Whether the primitive returned a dry-run receipt; a refusal before planning can report false.

state_generation.meaning: Reported generation of the certificate state, or 0 when not available.

client_reinstall_required.meaning: True after a successful rotation; false on a refusal.

message.meaning: Instruction returned when confirmation is absent or false.

ca_fingerprint_before.meaning: Fingerprint of the previous root, if any.

ca_fingerprint.meaning: SHA-256 fingerprint reported for the House CA certificate.

leaf_fingerprint.meaning: Fingerprint of the new leaf after rotation.

proof.meaning: Evidence named by the primitive for this outcome.
